[P1] Prevent late step results from starting serialization

This gate checks only operation entry. A running step that returns after the deadline still calls `safeSerialize` before reaching the disabled checkpoint. The built-in `createFileSystemSerdes` writes to a path determined by execution ARN and entity ID, so the old invocation can overwrite a result already stored and checkpointed by the retry. Check termination before starting result serialization and leave the operation unresolved. Add a regression that releases the old step after the retry stores its result.
